PART 1 (negative, primary): the standard isotropy-restriction i_x*:H^2_BW(Sk_C;D)->H^2(Aut(x);D(x)) kills [omega_h] (Sk_C is automorphism-rigid, so i_x* is the zero map), so 'stabiliser = isotropy-restriction of handoff' is FALSE. PART 1.5 (scope-correction): the geometric stabiliser class is defined only when s is aligned and is then 0 (aligned+normal => split); (Z/2,Z/2,Z/4) is never realised by an internal exact factorisation. PART 2 (obstruction): for EVERY functor F:A(down_join)->Sk_C, i_s*F*[omega_h]=0, so no comparison functor rescues the identification; the two sites are irreducibly distinct.
